desc: Model as edge subsets: each cell picks 2 of 4 ports (A: adjacent pair, B: opposite pair); no-dead-end ⇔ adjacent cells agree on shared edges ⇔ 2-factor of toroidal grid graph with turn/straight restrictions.

Key reduction: 2-factors that are boundaries ↔ 2-colorings of corner lattice; A ⇔ odd corner parity (linear), B ⇔ both diagonals anti-equal (linear); non-boundary windings recovered via 4 twisted boundary-condition sectors; answer = (1/2)(N00+N01+N10+N11).

Validate reference implementation on samples and brute-force cross-check tiny grids (harness written as `python file.py test`; division by 2 argued exact since complement acts freely on solution sets).

Design efficient propagation algorithm: propagate row-by-row from first row + first column (each cell determines x(i+1,j+1); B cells add check x(i+1,j)⊕x(i,j+1)=1); O(1)-support conjecture disproved, but bitset propagation + Gaussian elimination on n0=H+W-1 variables implemented.
Optimization pass: cache sector-independent masks across the 4 twist sectors (only constants p,q differ), reduce constraints online during propagation with early exit on contradiction.
Execute the test harness: verify samples (2,0,2), exhaustive 2×2/2×3/3×2 fast==ref==brute, random small/medium agreement, all-B sanity, and 1000×1000 timing.
If samples mismatch: fix suspected vertical-wrap RHS bug (use `top_c[j] = q if j==W else 0` in the wrap RHS) and replace the fragile B-check iterator with an explicit per-row indexed list.
If 1000×1000 timing is insufficient: shrink mask representation to reachable initial set, special-case long thin strips, or otherwise reduce big-int propagation cost.
Finalize solution: fast I/O for T up to 1e5 (sum HW ≤ 1e6), answer = (Σ N_{p,q})/2 mod 998244353, assert total even; verify edge cases H=2 or W=2 (wrap edges coincide) and inconsistent sectors (N=0).
